title: Tenma Tsukasa — Dance! And! Sing!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: A few days after returning
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Everyone, let's begin exchanging information regarding what we all learned from our trip to Riley Dream Park!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You all made sure to write everything down, right?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I missed this... We were only gone for a few days, but this idiotic banter really makes it feel like we've come home.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. We definitely had plenty to discuss while we were in the U.S., but there really is nothing quite like being back at the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui! Focus!
Do you have your lists ready?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. Also, we're just bouncing ideas off each other, not having a focused discussion.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I get that you're excited about getting back on stage but we need to get back to practicing, so can we get this over with?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Alright, let's begin!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, me! Pick me! When I saw how big and sparkly the main entrance was, I yelled, “Wowee♪”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, I see!
What did she mean by that, Rui...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You could try a little harder...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The main entrance was indeed spectacular and does a very good job of getting all the visitors excited about the park. I was impressed by it as well.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, what he said♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You expected me to figure all that out?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, I felt the same thing. That park had a way of overwhelming visitors with its majesty.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Me too. My favorite part was when all these buildings and objects I'd seen in the movies came into view after passing through the gate. I really felt like a kid again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, each area had a wonderful design to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, the castle from “The Little Kingdom” was magnificent, but I was absolutely staggered by how realistic the “Jungle Music” area felt.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We even got to hear how they consulted with actual botanists, constructed those imitation trees and even researched how jungles smell.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It totally felt like we were in a real jungle!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, the shows we saw were the biggest surprise for me. They were all way too good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Every time from start to finish, I was on the edge of my seat waiting to see what happens next.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, how each cast member portrayed their respective characters and the quality of their action sequences blew me away.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
In particular, that one wire stunt...
They somehow made it seem as if they weren't using any wires or contraptions at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But they must also know some clever tricks to be able to pull that off...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And above all else, the sheer acting ability of each cast member was beyond astonishing.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They all stayed in character even while putting on those wire harnesses during that one scene. It was as if they'd somehow become a part of their characters' costumes...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. Normally, you'd put them on while off the stage, but they made it a part of their act.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I were to do that scene right now, I doubt I'd be able to maintain my composure the way they did.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I can't even begin to imagine how much they had to practice to achieve such acting ability...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The king and prince especially... Their struggle seemed so real... They felt... Alive...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa...? Hello...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You seemed deep in thought just now.
Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, sorry.
I was just going over that one show we saw in my head.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know how you feel. The scenes that completely blew me away immediately pop back into my head every time I start thinking about that show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Because it really was a super amazing show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Indeed. We should thank Mr. Riley for giving us the chance to see it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, we definitely should!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, I believe that's everything in terms of what impressed us the most during our trip!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I've got everything written down too☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But it might take a while until we're able to use some of these ideas in our shows.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: To be fair, our stage, as well as this park, aren't exactly on the same scale.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But we can use what we learned to make up for that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure we'll be drawing upon what we experienced quite a bit moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup♪ My heart's going vroom-vroom already☆

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As is mine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we're setting out to put on shows that can make everybody smile, we'll need to put a polish on our existing ones first!

rows.Speaker: Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Yeah!
